articles.summary: AFP: 'My nightmare': Iranians recount crackdown under internet blackout. One move in the wrong direction and Kiarash would have been dead, he said, as a shooter opened fire on him and other protesters in the Iranian capital during a wave of demonstrations met by a deadly crackdown. If the shooter had been left-handed, Kiarash said, "I was dead."
